title: The Free Lead Scraper Still Costs $130 a Month
description:
There is a real open-source Claude Code skill for cold outbound, and it is genuinely good. But a skill cannot find email addresses on its own, and the repo's own README prices the stack it needs at about $360 for the first month and $130 every month after.

#shorts #claudecode #leadgeneration
